seo.title: Ângelo Salavessa — Black & Grey Realism Tattoo Artist
seo.description: Ângelo Salavessa is a black & grey realism tattoo artist tattooing worldwide — Amsterdam, Phuket and Portugal. Bookings open via WhatsApp.

text.hero.lede: Black & grey realism — portraits, wildlife, roses and symbols built for the body that wears them. Tattooing on the road between Amsterdam, Phuket and Portugal.
text.work.label: Selected work
text.work.title:
The
plates
text.work.introSerif: Build the dark. Protect the light.
text.work.intro: In black & grey, every highlight is skin left untouched — so the shadows have to do all the talking. A few pieces worth a closer look.
text.artist.label: The artist
text.artist.statement: Realism is a discipline of *restraint* — knowing where not to put ink.
text.artist.lead: Ângelo Salavessa works in black & grey realism: faces, animals, roses, statues and symbols, rendered in soft gradients that sit naturally on the body.
text.artist.p2: He works on the road. Amsterdam, Phuket and Portugal are among the regular stops, and the work goes wherever he lands next.
text.artist.p3: Every piece starts with your idea and is composed for the part of you it will live on. Larger work is planned across sessions — to be continued, as he puts it on his feed.
text.index.label: Archive
text.index.title: Index
text.process.label: Process
text.process.title:
From idea
to skin
text.process.lede: No templates, no surprises. Here is how a piece usually comes together — the details are always confirmed with you directly.
text.process.s1.title: The message
text.process.s1.text: Send the idea, the placement, a rough size and any references. Short is fine. The form below turns it into one clear WhatsApp message.
text.process.s2.title: The conversation
text.process.s2.text: What will actually work on your body: scale, flow, where the light falls on the muscle. Realism needs room — sometimes the honest answer is bigger, or simpler.
text.process.s3.title: The design
text.process.s3.text: The composition is built for you and your placement. Dates, deposits and session length are agreed directly when you book.
text.process.s4.title: The session
text.process.s4.text: Black & grey is built in layers — from the deepest shadow up to the highlights. Large pieces are split across sessions. To be continued.
text.process.s5.title: The healing
text.process.s5.text: Follow the aftercare you're given. Healed realism softens and settles into the skin — that's the version you live with, and the one that counts.
text.travel.label: Where to find him
text.travel.title:
On the
road
text.travel.lede: He tattoos where he travels. Guest-spot dates are announced on Instagram, so tell him in your enquiry where you'd like to be tattooed.
text.booking.label: Enquiry
text.booking.title:
Start
your *piece.*
text.booking.intro: Bookings are open and handled personally on WhatsApp. Describe your idea here and the form turns it into one clear message — nothing gets lost in a long chat.
text.booking.next1: Fill in what you know. Only a few fields are required.
text.booking.next2: Review the message we put together for you.
text.booking.next3: WhatsApp opens with it already written. Tap send — that's the moment it's actually sent.
text.booking.submitNote: Nothing is sent from this page. You'll see the full message first, then send it yourself.
text.closing.kicker: Questions, dates, an idea you can't shake
